identity.description: Pumble is a team messaging/chat app (pumble.com), published by CAKE.com. Its help center and developer materials describe a Pumble API add-on, an API reference, an SDK, and a native MCP server.
identity.identity_notes: The Pumble help center, the CAKE.com update page and the CAKE-com GitHub SDK all describe the same product. The API docs page rendered only as a 'Scalar API Reference' title, so its endpoint list was not verified.

auth.scopes_notes: Per the Pumble SDK page, each request must be sent with an x-app-token header (the App key) and a token header (user or bot token); the SDK says method calls can run on behalf of either a user or a bot. The Swagger doc's scope requirements were not verified.

access.production_restrictions: No production restrictions were found in the sources reviewed. Whether a workspace admin must install the API addon before a developer can get a key is not established.

read_ops: list the user's channels and DMs
api.limitations: The full endpoint list is in a Swagger/Scalar reference that did not render, so breadth is inferred from help-article examples and SDK resource groups. Webhook support was not found.

open_questions: Does the Pumble add-on install require a workspace admin or owner? The API key article lists Owner, Admin, Member as roles that can use the feature, but not who can install the add-on.
